data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Marissa derives from the name Mara, meaning 'bitter' or 'rebellious'. In the Bible, Marissa is not a direct name, but it can be connected to the name Mary, meaning 'rebellious', which is the most common biblical name for females. The name Marissa carries the meaning “Rebellious one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Marissa usually hope their child will grow to embody rebellious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Μαρίσα
